english.note: Use 兄弟 as the all-purpose term when the sibling's age is unspecified, and also for a male comrade or fellow member of a cause; context can include a half-brother or stepbrother.

boxes.meaning: bro, buddy (friendly address to a man)

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose casual address for a male friend or acquaintance, especially when saying “dude” or “bro.”
Use this male-oriented “bro” style term for a close buddy or an informal, sometimes confrontational address.
Use this for a male buddy or as a friendly address to a male peer, especially a stranger of similar age.
Use this for a male friend or group of male friends in the sense of “bro” or “the boys.”
Use 兄弟 when informally addressing an unfamiliar man in a friendly or confrontational way.
